sources: https://www.riseupreidsville.com/_files/ugd/2463ad_f691f3e18f7641a3be30c58d90949e7e.pdf (city Lake Reidsville pamphlet, created 2025-10-09; camping panel read as an image)

values.note: Daily: City residents $35 full hookup, $40 water/electric; non-city $50 full hookup, $55 water/electric (as printed: full hookup is the cheaper of the two). Group tent sites $25 city / $50 non-city, off-season only. Monthly (full hookup, 2 adults, $1 per extra person) $600 city / $1,200 non-city. The non-resident charge is by CITY residence.

fees.source: https://www.riseupreidsville.com/_files/ugd/2463ad_f691f3e18f7641a3be30c58d90949e7e.pdf ('Daily Rates: City $40 W&E $35 Full Hookup; Non-City $55 W&E $50 Full Hookup'; 'Monthly Rates: ... City: $600 Full Hookup Non-City: $1200 Full Hookup'; PDF created 2025-10-09), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.riseupreidsville.com/_files/ugd/2463ad_f691f3e18f7641a3be30c58d90949e7e.pdf ('46 wooded sites, all with water and electricity; 28 sites are full hook-up'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 46 wooded sites, all with water and electric; 28 of them full hook-up. 'Camping options for tents, pop-ups, and small to large RVs.'
Hot showers and restrooms; camp store open daily 6am-5pm in summer, 8am-2pm in winter (fishing licenses, bait, firewood $5).

facilities.source: https://www.riseupreidsville.com/_files/ugd/2463ad_f691f3e18f7641a3be30c58d90949e7e.pdf ('hot water shower facilities, restrooms, boat dock, fishing piers and nature trails', 'The campground store is open everyday from 6am-5pm in the summer and 8am-2pm in the winter'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.riseupreidsville.com/lake-reidsville ('Lake Reidsville is open year round and offers camping options for tents, pop-ups, and small to large RVs') + the pamphlet ('Campground Seasons In season: April 1-October 31 Off-Season: November 1-March 31'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Call 336-349-4738 to make reservations.' Daily sites can stay up to 14 days on and 14 days off; monthly sites run 1st to 1st, one month on and one month off.

booking.source: https://www.riseupreidsville.com/lake-reidsville ('Call 336-349-4738 to make reservations') + pamphlet ('Daily sites can stay up to 14 days on and 14 days off', 'Monthly sites run from the 1st to 1st of the month and one month on, one month off'), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Reidsville campground in a 750-acre lake park; about 8 lakefront sites fill fast. Fishing piers, boat dock, boat storage, disc golf, 3+ miles of trails; no swimming or jet skis (the lake is the city's water supply). Some sites are let monthly. --Claude
summary: Priced from the city's 2025 pamphlet: city residents $35 full hookup / $40 water-electric, non-city $50 / $55; confirmed 46 sites (28 full hookup), hot showers, phone reservations; added camp store, year-round season, 14-night limit. Amperage not stated. Note trimmed of hookup/count/booking text.
flags: Dead website: http://www.ci.reidsville.nc.us/... no longer resolves. The City of Reidsville's current Lake Reidsville page is https://www.riseupreidsville.com/lake-reidsville (the city's site, '©2018 by City of Reidsville'); reidsvillenc.gov refuses automated reads.
Odd as printed: the city lists full hookup ($35 city / $50 non-city) as cheaper than water/electric ($40 / $55). Recorded as printed.
